parameters.query:
SELECT s.Session_ID AS session_id, GROUP_CONCAT(rp.Permission_Code SEPARATOR ',') AS permissions
FROM Dashboard_Sessions s
JOIN Dashboard_Users u ON u.User_ID=s.User_ID
LEFT JOIN Dashboard_Role_Permissions rp ON rp.Role_Code=u.Role_Code
WHERE s.Token_Hash='{{ String($json.token_hash).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  AND s.Revoked_At IS NULL
  AND s.Expires_At>UTC_TIMESTAMP()
GROUP BY s.Session_ID
LIMIT 1;
